title: Claim Ledger
description: Every rendered answer originates from a structured claim ledger. A fact claim MUST cite supporting evidence; unsupported claims are prohibited (claims.unsupported_claims_max == 0). Reconciled from handoff-audit/phase1-design/schemas/claim_ledger.v1.schema.json against docs/spatialrag_migration/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §3 (see schemas/contracts/README.md).

claim_type.description: Widened from the original FACT|INFERENCE draft to include HYPOTHESIS and COMPARISON per DATA_CONTRACTS.md §3.

confidence_basis.description: Named signals (e.g. ["tier_1_source", "cross_producer_corroboration", "high_retrieval_score"]), not a bare confidence float with no explanation. Widened from a single string in the original draft per DATA_CONTRACTS.md §3.

x-invariants: Contradictions are preserved, never silently reconciled (contradictions.silent_conflict_resolution_max == 0).
Citations resolve to document page and exact region (citations.exact_page_resolution_min == 0.98).
